context: Ren interviews a historian on diplomacy.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: expert interview; vocabulary (革命/危機/違反/被告/外交) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 外交の歴史を、研究されていますね。
lines.en: You research the history of diplomacy.
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、危機の時代に注目しています。
lines.en: Yes, I focus on eras of crisis.
lines.style: composed historian voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 革命は、外交をどう変えましたか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 革命が、新しい外交を生みました。
lines.en: Revolutions gave rise to new diplomacy.
lines.style: patient historian voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国際法の違反は、多かったですか?
lines.en: Were violations of international law common?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 違反を巡る危機が、何度もありました。
lines.en: Crises over violations occurred many times.
lines.style: composed historian voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 責任者が、被告になった例も?
lines.en: Were there cases of officials becoming defendants?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被告として、裁かれた例もあります。
lines.en: There are cases of being tried as defendants.
lines.style: warm historian voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
